root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: The delete-IP notification payload must not alias the `net->ro._l_addr` storage of the `net` already removed by the immediately preceding `sctp_remove_net(stcb, net)`.
root_cause_criterion.criterion: When the delete-IP path notifies the upper layer, the pointer forwarded to `sctp_ulp_notify()` must come from an independent live address object, not from the `net->ro._l_addr` field of the `net` just removed from the association.
root_cause_criterion.description: The crashing path calls `sctp_remove_net(stcb, net)` and then immediately forwards `&net->ro._l_addr` into the delete-IP notification. That reuses storage owned by the removed `struct sctp_nets`, so the later `sa->sa_family` read observes freed memory. Safe sibling executions can still remove a destination net but notify with a different live address object, which keeps the sink argument separate from the removed net storage.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable original violates this predicate at `delete_notify_call`, but the fixed original never executes `delete_notify_call`. The two closest packet-only perturbations that removed the AUTH wrapper also never exercised the event on either side, because the fixed harness forces `auth_supported = 0` while ASCONF remains auth-required, preventing a genuine fixed-side witness for this rooted obligation.

nodes.state: The delete helper selects a non-source `net` and passes it to `sctp_remove_net(stcb, net)`, so the storage containing `net->ro._l_addr` becomes stale on the crashing path before the later delete-IP notification is emitted.

`sctp_notify_peer_addr_change()` dereferences the forwarded delete-notification pointer as `sa` and reads `sa->sa_family`, which is the AddressSanitizer-reported heap-use-after-free read in the vulnerable execution.

edges.relation: After `sctp_remove_net(stcb, net)` removes the selected destination net, the same `&net->ro._l_addr` pointer is immediately reused as the delete-IP notification payload in the vulnerable delete-all helper.
The pointer chosen as the delete-IP notification payload is forwarded unchanged through `sctp_ulp_notify()` into `sctp_notify_peer_addr_change()` as the `sa` argument that the sink dereferences.
